summary: Iteration 39 — toner cartridge SVG/title rework + 12-brand canonical lists + bulk model-search. Backend regressions PASS (5/5 pytest in test_iteration39_brands.py — toner search returns brand='Canon' only with non-empty model_number; /api/compat/printers Canon LBP search returns 18 hits). Frontend PASS for buyer-facing surfaces: /search?category=toners shows 21 cards, each with the red-band cartridge SVG containing ONLY the brand text ('CANON'), corner label 'Canon', product-title-{id} (e.g. 'CARTRIDGE CANON 071') at exactly 19px, product-compat-{id} starting with 'Fits: ' at 11.5px (data-testid present). Toner detail page (/toner/{id}) renders the generated SVG inside data-testid='product-image-main' (no 'No image uploaded' fallback), Add to Cart + Buy now present. Add-to-cart from /search appends to tc_cart_v1 (cart=1, success toast 'Added Canon CARTRIDGE CANON 071 to cart'). Buy-now navigates to /checkout with the correct line item. SUPPLIER DASHBOARD COULD NOT BE TESTED — supplier credentials qadealer@tonerscart.in / Dealer@123 (per request + /app/memory/test_credentials.md) return 401 'Incorrect email or password' from POST /api/auth/login, so the listing-brand-select / bulk-cell-0-brand / ModelSearchCell flows are UNVERIFIED end-to-end on the live UI.

rca of the issue: Supplier-login 401 RCA — the request + /app/memory/test_credentials.md both say qadealer@tonerscart.in / Dealer@123 is an approved supplier, but Supabase Auth rejects the password. Possible causes: (a) the account was rotated since the credentials file was last updated, (b) the seed/setup script did not run on this preview environment, (c) someone changed the dealer's password manually in Supabase. Mitigation: main agent should either (i) update the supplier's password back to Dealer@123 in Supabase, (ii) create a fresh approved supplier via the admin approve flow and refresh test_credentials.md, or (iii) point the script-based seed at this preview environment so qadealer@tonerscart.in/Dealer@123 is recreated.
